name: TrialSetu - Voice-Based Adverse Event (AE) Ingestion & PV Paging

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "study_id": "{{ $('Webhook: Voice/Field Intake').item.json.body.study_id || 'AIIA-GUDU-03' }}",
  "participant_id": "{{ $('Webhook: Voice/Field Intake').item.json.body.participant_id || 'PT-GUDU-201' }}",
  "description": "{{ $('Webhook: Voice/Field Intake').item.json.body.transcript || $node['Whisper Speech-to-Text'].json.text }}",
  "severity": "{{ $('TrialSetu Live MedDRA Auto-Coder').item.json.severity }}",
  "meddra_code": "{{ $('TrialSetu Live MedDRA Auto-Coder').item.json.meddra_code }}",
  "meddra_label": "{{ $('TrialSetu Live MedDRA Auto-Coder').item.json.meddra_label }}",
  "whodrug_code": "{{ $('TrialSetu Live MedDRA Auto-Coder').item.json.whodrug_code }}",
  "source": "voice_report"
}

nodes.name: Commit AE to TrialSetu DB & SSE Stream

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "success",
  "ae_reference": "{{ $json.adverse_event.id }}",
  "study_id": "{{ $json.adverse_event.study_id }}",
  "meddra_label": "{{ $json.adverse_event.meddra_label }}",
  "severity": "{{ $json.adverse_event.severity }}",
  "pv_on_call_paged": {{ $json.adverse_event.severity === 'serious' }},
  "regulatory_deadline": "{{ $json.adverse_event.report_deadline }}",
  "confirmation_message": "Your adverse event report has been securely registered in TrialSetu CTMS under ALCOA+ compliance. The National Pharmacovigilance Coordination Centre has been alerted."
}
